Strategically positioned in the vibrant port city of Ningbo, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION stands as a distinguished and dynamic force in the global chemical industry. Our products form the essential building blocks for a multitude of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, agriculture, textiles, water treatment, and advanced manufacturing. By adhering to the most stringent international standards and investing continuously in research and development, we ensure that our clients receive products that not only meet but exceed their expectations for performance and purity.

As we look to the future, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION is committed to pioneering sustainable practices and driving innovation that contributes to a safer, more efficient, and prosperous world through the power of chemistry.
